name: "Cuidemos a Panamá" National Plan for Post-COVID-19 Response
content: Problems and Purpose "Cuidemos a Panamá" ("Let's take care of Panama") is a Panamanian civil society initiative that seeks to create a National Plan proposal for after the COVID-19 pandemic. The Plan aimed to identify citizen demands and responses to the challenges the country faces. Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Participant Recruitment and Selection Methods and Tools Used What Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation The plan was developed throughout 17 Social Dialogues, which were organized in 9 working tables. Each table addressed one of the following topics: institutional changes and justice, science and health, indigenous peoples, gender, youth, environment, human rights and social production. More than 300 citizens participated in the online meetings, which were held between April and July 2020.
